title: FFI 6/8: phenomena, nodes/apsides, orbital elements, crossings
description:
### Summary
FFI wrappers for planetary phenomena, nodes/apsides, orbital elements, and the crossing-finder family. Read docs/ffi-design.md and the established swisseph-ffi patterns first.

### Files
- `swisseph-ffi/src/pheno.rs` (new module), header regen, `swisseph-ffi/tests/pheno.rs`

### Functions to add
1. `swisseph_pheno(h, tjd_et, ipl, iflag, attr: *mut f64 /*[20]*/, flags_used out)` + `swisseph_pheno_ut` (context.rs:774/785). Phenomena fields → attr[0..5] (phase angle, phase, elongation, apparent diameter, apparent magnitude, horizontal parallax), rest zeroed.
2. `swisseph_nod_aps(h, tjd_et, ipl, iflag, method: i32 /* NodApsMethod bits */, xnasc[6], xndsc[6], xperi[6], xaphe[6] all out)` + `swisseph_nod_aps_ut` (context.rs:928/946). NodesApsides' four [f64;6] arrays map 1:1.
3. `swisseph_get_orbital_elements(h, tjd_et, ipl, iflag, dret: *mut f64 /*[50]*/)` (context.rs:963) — use `OrbitalElements::as_array` (src/orbit.rs:118) for the C slot layout; zero the tail.
4. `swisseph_orbit_max_min_true_distance(h, tjd_et, ipl, iflag, dmax out, dmin out, dtrue out)` (context.rs:975).
5. Crossings (context.rs:990–1048): `swisseph_solcross(h, x2cross, tjd_et, iflag, jx out) -> i32` + `_ut`; `swisseph_mooncross` + `_ut`; `swisseph_mooncross_node(h, tjd_et, iflag, xlon out, xlat out, jx out)` + `_ut`; `swisseph_helio_cross(h, ipl, x2cross, tjd_et, iflag, dir: i32, jx out)` + `_ut`. NOTE: C returns the crossing JD as the double return value with jx < tjd meaning error — do NOT copy that; use our uniform i32-code + `jx` out-param convention (this is a deliberate, documented divergence from the C signature; the header comment must say so since the Dart side needs to adapt).

### Tests
Parity vs lib (Moshier): pheno for Venus/Moon at 2 epochs; nod_aps MEAN + OSCU for Moon and Mars, all four points bitwise; orbital elements for Jupiter vs `as_array`; solcross/mooncross forward from a known epoch, jx bitwise; mooncross_node; helio_cross both directions; error paths (Sun crossing itself via helio_cross(Sun)? — whatever the lib rejects, assert the mapped code).

### Acceptance criteria
- `cargo test -p swisseph-ffi` and root `cargo test` pass; header freshness green
- Header documents dret[50] slot meanings for orbital elements (copy from OrbitalElements docs) and the crossings return-convention divergence from C

### Escape hatch
If `as_array` doesn't cover all 50 C slots, zero the uncovered ones and document; if any wrapper needs lib-crate changes beyond visibility, STOP and report instead of patching the lib here.
execution_record: Straightforward implementation — all 16 FFI functions followed the established eclipse.rs/lib.rs patterns. 20 parity tests (FFI vs lib) + 3 error-path tests, all bitwise-exact (1e-15 eps). No lib-crate changes needed. Header regenerated via cbindgen, freshness test green.
